arguments.value: Football Northwest LLC gave Mercata, Inc. a sponsorship package for the 1999 Seattle Seahawks season and Kingdome events in exchange for a $40,000 fee. Mercata received TV ads and on-air mentions during preseason games, DiamondVision promotions at the stadium, online advertising and store promotion on Seahawks.com, and VIP benefits such as tickets, a training camp trip, and advertising space. The agreement ran from July 19, 1999 until the sponsorship benefits were delivered, but no later than the end of the 1999 season. It could be terminated on notice if the stadium was badly damaged, the Seahawks franchise was cancelled or moved far away, or either side materially defaulted. Each party kept ownership of its own trademarks, advertising content had to be approved, the parties agreed to indemnify each other for certain claims, disputes were subject to Washington law and arbitration, and the agreement was confidential except for limited disclosures.
